title: CUDA graphs and launch overhead
brief: Pick a batch-size bucket, measure padding waste, and capture a decode step whose replay matches eager execution.
hints: The smallest bucket that is at least the real batch is the one you pad to. A batch past every bucket has no graph.
Waste is idle padded slots over padded slots. Powers of two are a legal set, and a tighter set can waste less on the same trace.
Capture after a warmup on a side stream. Replay reads the same addresses, so copy new values in with copy_ rather than rebinding the name.
A host sync, a Python slice bound that changes, and empty_cache all fail the capture rules. The CPU check grades those names. It does not run capture.
